oracleRisk.summary: GBPA is a fixed GBP-par issuer token, not a floating NAV share or collateralized borrower position. Fiat mint and redemption quantities do not use a token price oracle; money-market reserve valuation and issuer control remain separate Backing and Control questions.

branchApplicability.rationale: Agant defines GBP 1 face-value redemption. applicability.rationale: The exact implementation mints a requested nominal quantity under the authorized minter map, and the holder claim remains fixed GBP par rather than NAV. No borrower or liquidation-price branch exists.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: All five deployments are issuer-native liabilities with separate LayerZero interoperability. October 15 pins retain all four peers, send/receive libraries, four required DVNs and one-signature worker rosters on Ethereum, Base, Arc and Tempo. Solana's freeze-authority wallet also holds the OFT program upgrade authority and can replace Store mint-signing logic. Solana validation and exact Tempo executable authorization remain unresolved; current configuration is not immutable conservation or independent-key proof.
